title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Specifically Apply the Provisions of Article 56 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of Civil Policies and Laws

articles.content_en:
Reply on the Provisions of Article 56
(1987) Min Ta Zi No. 42
Higher People's Court of Liaoning Province:
Your court's request dated June 19, 1987, (87) Min Fu Zi No. 14, regarding how to apply the provisions of Article 56 of the Supreme People's Court's Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of Civil Policy and Law (hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions") after the implementation of the Regulations on the Administration of Urban Private Houses (hereinafter referred to as the "Regulations"), has been received.
Upon study, we agree with the opinion of the adjudication committee of your court, i.e., the spirit of the provisions of Article 56 of the "Opinions" shall only apply to resolving historical legacy issues existing before the implementation of the "Regulations"; after the implementation of the "Regulations", when the People's Court adjudicates cases of this kind, it shall strictly follow the provisions of the "Regulations".
This reply.
December 10, 1987
